en.t: The lady replied, "You absolutely must not!

units.source_text: 听京中人说，这个人娶的身份高贵的夫人，不知多多少少。

en.t: People in the capital say that this man has married no end of high-ranking ladies.

units.source_text: 并且东偷西摸，连皇上的妃子都触犯到，为此闹得天翻地覆。

en.t: And he has been carrying on affairs everywhere, even offending one of the emperor's consorts, which caused a tremendous uproar.

units.source_text: 这个人哪里会把我们这种乡下姑娘放在心上呢？”

en.t: How could such a man ever take a country girl like ours to heart?"

units.source_text: 明石道人冒起火来，说道：“你不懂事！

en.t: The Akashi monk flew into a temper and said, "You understand nothing!

units.source_text: 先要找个机会，请他到这里来。”

en.t: First we must find an opportunity to invite him here."
He clung stubbornly to his own view and went ahead entirely on his own.

units.source_text: 就把屋子装饰得富丽堂皇，关切地替女儿操心。

en.t: So he decorated the room in splendid style and anxiously busied himself over his daughter's affairs.
